name: IDFC FIRST Bank Ltd.
business_summary: Retail-focused private bank formed in 2018 from IDFC Bank and Capital First; widely held (no promoter; FII 36.7%, DII 25.4%, govt 7.8%). Loan book ~Rs2.7 lakh cr (derived) growing ~30% (Q2 FY27) in consumer finance, vehicles, MSME, cards and MFI, funded by a rapidly built CASA/retail deposit base. Profit recovered from FY26 trough: Q1 FY27 Rs1,075cr, Q2 Rs1,045cr (~3x Rs352cr a year earlier) but RoE only ~4-6% and TTM profit Rs2,941cr on a Rs66k cr market cap.

revenue_mix.segment: retail & business banking (vehicle, consumer, cards, MFI, home)

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost: loans ~Rs2.7 lakh cr (derived; revenue/yield) x 0.5% = Rs1,350cr vs TTM PBT ~Rs3,900cr (PAT 2,941/0.75) => PBT -35%, PAT -35%; persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1.0 => -17; trimmed to -14 because management can offset with lower opex. Earnings base is thin (ROE 3.8%) so the stock is far more convex to credit cost than ICICI (-4.2).

evidence.note: screener: Sep-2026 qtr net profit Rs1,045cr, TTM Rs2,941cr, mcap Rs66,170cr, P/B ~1.35, ROE 3.8%; empirical sensitivities
Q2 FY27 profit Rs1,045cr (~3x YoY), loan assets +30% (Times of India/ET headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Cards, personal loans, MFI and consumer-finance are ~25-30% of loans (model knowledge). +1pp delinquencies x 27% x 60% loss = 16bp of loans = Rs440cr = ~11% of PBT; persistence 0.5 => -5.5, rounded -5. This is the swing factor behind the FY26 earnings trough (Mar-2026 qtr profit only Rs319cr).

evidence.note: screener: Sep-2026 qtr net profit Rs1,045cr, TTM Rs2,941cr, mcap Rs66,170cr, P/B ~1.35, ROE 3.8%; empirical sensitivities

exposures.mechanism: +3pp system credit growth: IDFC is growing ~25-30% (loan assets +30% in Q2) so incremental system growth adds ~+3pp to its own growth, NII +3%, PAT +8% on operating leverage (fixed-cost base) x persistence 0.5 => +2.5-3.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 profit Rs1,045cr (~3x YoY), loan assets +30% (Times of India/ET headlines)

exposures.mechanism: IDFC is deposit-dependent (CASA ~47%, retail deposits ~80%+ of funding; model knowledge): +3pp system deposit growth -> CoF -8bp on ~5.8% (interest 5,737 on revenue 11,922 in Q2) => NIM +5bp = +1.5% NII, PAT +5%; persistence 0.5 => +2.5. Cost of deposits is the key lever behind the NIM recovery story.
